def conservation(vertices, rings, moments, connectivity, domain_area, area_readouts):
    cell_results, edge_normals = ([], [[] for _ in connectivity['edges']])
    for owner, ring in enumerate(rings):
        closure = [Fraction(0), Fraction(0)]
        affine = [[Fraction(0), Fraction(0)] for _ in range(2)]
        normals = []
        for local, b in enumerate(ring):
            a = ring[local - 1]
            start, end = (vertices[a], vertices[b])
            normal = (end[1] - start[1], start[0] - end[0])
            midpoint = tuple(((x + y) / 2 for x, y in zip(start, end, strict=True)))
            occurrence = connectivity['occurrences'][connectivity['cell_occurrences'][owner][local]]
            edge_normals[occurrence['edge']].append((owner, normal))
            normals.append(normal)
            for j in range(2):
                closure[j] += normal[j]
                for k in range(2):
                    affine[k][j] += midpoint[k] * normal[j]
        area = moments[owner][0]
        defect = [[affine[k][j] - (area if k == j else 0) for j in range(2)] for k in range(2)]
        if any(closure) or any((value for row in defect for value in row)):
            raise ValueError('Constant/affine flux closure or exact area conservation failed')
        cell_results.append(dict(integrated_line_normals_xy_m=normals, constant_flux_closure=closure, affine_flux_moments_m2=affine, affine_area_defect_m2=defect))
    internal = []
    for edge, row in enumerate(edge_normals):
        if len(row) == 2:
            residual = tuple((row[0][1][axis] + row[1][1][axis] for axis in range(2)))
            if any(residual):
                raise ValueError('Opposite shared-edge fluxes failed exact cancellation')
            internal.append(dict(edge=edge, owners=[item[0] for item in row], residual=residual))
    return dict(cells=cell_results, internal_edge_cancellation=internal, exact_stored_geometry_area_sum=sum((row[0] for row in moments), Fraction(0)), declared_domain_area_exact=domain_area, stored_geometry_domain_area_defect=sum((row[0] for row in moments), Fraction(0)) - domain_area, rounded_area_readout_sum_defect=sum((Fraction.from_float(x) for x in area_readouts), Fraction(0)) - domain_area, binary64_area_readouts_sum_exactly_claimed=False, unit_normals_physical_membranes_and_height_used=False)

def independent_partition(seeds, domain, partial):
    domain_lines = [edge_plane(domain[i - 1], point) for i, point in enumerate(domain)]
    candidates, all_lines = ([], [])
    journal = []
    partial['constraint_intersection_construction'] = journal
    for owner, seed in enumerate(seeds):
        lines = domain_lines + [site_plane(seed, p) for other, p in enumerate(seeds) if other != owner]
        entry = dict(owner=owner, constraints=lines, pairs=[])
        journal.append(entry)
        feasible = set()
        for left in range(len(lines)):
            for right in range(left + 1, len(lines)):
                trial = dict(left=left, right=right)
                entry['pairs'].append(trial)
                value = intersection(lines[left], lines[right])
                trial['intersection'] = value
                if value is None:
                    trial['status'] = 'parallel'
                    continue
                violated = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if slack(line, value) < 0), None)
                trial['first_violated_constraint'] = violated
                trial['status'] = 'outside' if violated is not None else 'feasible'
                if violated is None:
                    feasible.add(value)
        candidates.append(hull(feasible))
        all_lines.append(lines)
    vertices = sorted({point for row in candidates for point in row})
    if len(vertices) > 256:
        raise ValueError('Independent global vertex bound exceeded')
    rings = []
    for owner, lines in enumerate(all_lines):
        selected = [i for i, value in enumerate(vertices) if all((slack(line, value) >= 0 for line in lines)) and any((slack(line, value) == 0 for line in lines))]
        seed = seeds[owner]

        def compare(left, right, seed=seed):
            if left == right:
                return 0
            a = (vertices[left][0] - seed[0], vertices[left][1] - seed[1])
            b = (vertices[right][0] - seed[0], vertices[right][1] - seed[1])
            ah = int(a[1] < 0 or (a[1] == 0 and a[0] < 0))
            bh = int(b[1] < 0 or (b[1] == 0 and b[0] < 0))
            if ah != bh:
                return ah - bh
            orientation = cross(a, b)
            if not orientation:
                raise ValueError('Independent distinct boundary points share a seed ray')
            return -1 if orientation > 0 else 1
        selected.sort(key=cmp_to_key(compare))
        first = selected.index(min(selected))
        rings.append(tuple(selected[first:] + selected[:first]))
    if sum(map(len, rings)) > 512:
        raise ValueError('Independent complete occurrence bound exceeded')
    return (tuple(vertices), tuple(rings))

@type_check
def _make_cell_lattice(self, p: 'betse.science.parameters.Parameters') -> None:
    """
        Create the randomly scattered lattice of **cell seed points** (i.e.,
        cell centres) defined on a 2D world space, with dimensions supplied by
        the :attr:`wsx` variable in meters.

        Specifically, this method defines the following object attributes:

        * ``xmin``, ``xmax``, ``ymin``, ``ymax``, the minimum and maximum points
          of the global world space.
        * ``centre``, the centre of the global world space.
        * ``clust_xy``, the list of `(x, y)` Cartesian coordinates of seed
          points.

        The amount of deviation from a square grid is specified by the
        :attr:`cell_lattice_disorder` variable, defined from 0 (perfect square
        grid) to 1 (full noise).

        Parameters
        -----------
        p : Parameters
            Current simulation configuration.
        """
    if p.cell_lattice_type is CellLatticeType.SQUARE:
        logs.log_info('Creating square cell lattice...')
        x_v = np.linspace(0, (p.nx - 1) * (p.d_cell + p.ac), p.nx)
        y_v = np.linspace(0, (p.ny - 1) * (p.d_cell + p.ac), p.ny)
        x_2d, y_2d = np.meshgrid(x_v, y_v)
        x_rnd = p.cell_lattice_disorder * p.d_cell * (np.random.rand(p.ny, p.nx) - 0.5)
        y_rnd = p.cell_lattice_disorder * p.d_cell * (np.random.rand(p.ny, p.nx) - 0.5)
        x_2d = x_2d + x_rnd
        y_2d = y_2d + y_rnd
        xypts = np.vstack((x_2d.ravel(), y_2d.ravel())).T
    elif p.cell_lattice_type is CellLatticeType.HEX:
        logs.log_info('Creating hexagonal cell lattice...')
        r = p.d_cell / 2
        a_hex = np.sqrt(3) * r
        b_hex = 3 * r
        blue_y_start = a_hex / 2
        blue_y_end = p.wsx - a_hex / 2
        blue_x_start = 0
        blue_x_end = p.wsy
        blue_space_y = a_hex
        blue_space_x = b_hex
        blue_x_num = int((blue_x_end - blue_x_start) / blue_space_x)
        blue_y_num = int((blue_y_end - blue_y_start) / blue_space_y)
        red_y_start = 0
        red_y_end = p.wsx
        red_x_start = b_hex / 2
        red_x_end = p.wsy - b_hex / 2
        red_space_y = a_hex
        red_space_x = b_hex
        red_x_num = int((red_x_end - red_x_start) / red_space_x)
        red_y_num = int((red_y_end - red_y_start) / red_space_y)
        x_blue = np.linspace(blue_x_start, blue_x_end, blue_x_num)
        y_blue = np.linspace(blue_y_start, blue_y_end, blue_y_num)
        x_red = np.linspace(red_x_start, red_x_end, red_x_num)
        y_red = np.linspace(red_y_start, red_y_end, red_y_num)
        x_2d_blue, y_2d_blue = np.meshgrid(x_blue, y_blue)
        x_2d_red, y_2d_red = np.meshgrid(x_red, y_red)
        x_2d = np.hstack((x_2d_blue.ravel(), x_2d_red.ravel()))
        y_2d = np.hstack((y_2d_blue.ravel(), y_2d_red.ravel()))
        x_rnd = p.cell_lattice_disorder * p.d_cell * (np.random.rand(len(x_2d)) - 0.5)
        y_rnd = p.cell_lattice_disorder * p.d_cell * (np.random.rand(len(y_2d)) - 0.5)
        x_2d = x_2d + x_rnd
        y_2d = y_2d + y_rnd
        xypts = np.vstack((x_2d, y_2d)).T
    else:
        raise BetseSimConfException('Cell lattice type "{}" unrecognized.'.format(p.cell_lattice_type))
    self.xmin = np.min(xypts[:, 0])
    self.xmax = np.max(xypts[:, 0])
    self.ymin = np.min(xypts[:, 1])
    self.ymax = np.max(xypts[:, 1])
    bbox = np.asarray([[self.xmin, self.ymin], [self.xmax, self.ymin], [self.xmax, self.ymax], [self.xmin, self.ymax]])
    self.centre = xypts.mean(axis=0)
    self.clust_xy = np.vstack((xypts, bbox))
    self.bbox = np.asarray([[self.xmin - p.cell_radius, self.ymin - p.cell_radius], [self.xmax + p.cell_radius, self.ymin - p.cell_radius], [self.xmax + p.cell_radius, self.ymax + p.cell_radius], [self.xmin - p.cell_radius, self.ymax + p.cell_radius]])
    self.xmin = self.xmin - p.cell_radius
    self.ymin = self.ymin - p.cell_radius
    self.xmax = self.xmax + p.cell_radius
    self.ymax = self.ymax + p.cell_radius
    self.xyaxis = [self.xmin, self.xmax, self.ymin, self.ymax]

def create_mappings(self, ignoreb=False):
    """
        Make various mappings for the tri-mesh.
        """
    face_to_edges = [[] for ii in range(self.n_tcell)]
    verts_to_edges = [[] for i in range(len(self.tri_verts))]
    edge_tree = cKDTree(self.tri_edges)
    for ci, vertsi_o in enumerate(self.tri_cells):
        vertsi_i = np.roll(vertsi_o, -1)
        for vi, vj in zip(vertsi_o, vertsi_i):
            dist_e, ea = edge_tree.query([vi, vj])
            if dist_e == 0.0:
                face_to_edges[ci].append(ea)
                verts_to_edges[vi].append(ea)
                verts_to_edges[vj].append(ea)
    self.tcell_to_tedges = np.asarray(face_to_edges, dtype=object)
    self.tverts_to_tedges = np.asarray(verts_to_edges, dtype=object)
    tedges_to_tcell = [[] for xi in self.tri_edges]
    for tcell_i, edge_inds in enumerate(self.tcell_to_tedges):
        for ei in edge_inds:
            tedges_to_tcell[ei].append(tcell_i)
    self.tedges_to_tcell = np.asarray(tedges_to_tcell, dtype=object)
    if ignoreb is False:
        bcellso = self.tedges_to_tcell[self.bflags_tedges]
        self.bflags_tcells = np.asarray([b[0] for b in bcellso])

def create_tri_map(self):
    """
        Create the basic mapping between triverts and simplices.
        """
    tverts_to_tcell = [[] for i in range(len(self.tri_verts))]
    self.free_to_merge = set()
    for ci, vertsi_o in enumerate(self.tri_cells):
        self.free_to_merge.add(ci)

def define_vorverts(self):
    """
        Add perpendicular bisectors into the vor mesh.

        When constructing a voronoi diagram, the vor mesh edges intersecting
        the incredible hull of the tri mesh must be defined by a new set of vor
        mesh vertices added outside the tri mesh hull. This method adds these
        perpendicular bisectors into the vor mesh.
        """
    logs.log_info('Calculating Voronoi cells...')
    vcell_verts = []
    vor_verts = []
    vor_sa = []
    vor_cents = []
    vor_edge_verts = []
    tri_sa_o = []
    for ti, tc_indso in enumerate(self._tverts_to_tcell):
        tc_inds = np.unique(tc_indso)
        assert len(tc_indso) != 0, 'Tri-vert belongs to no simplices!'
        if self.use_centroids:
            vvertso = self.tri_cents[tc_inds]
        else:
            vvertso = self.tri_ccents[tc_inds]
        trisai = self.tri_sa[tc_inds]
        if ti in self.bflags_tverts:
            tedge_inds = np.unique(self.tverts_to_tedges[ti])
            for tei in tedge_inds:
                if tei in self.bflags_tedges:
                    bedge_verts = self.tri_verts[self.tri_edges[tei]]
                    bedge_mid = np.mean(bedge_verts, axis=0)
                    simp_i = self.tedges_to_tcell[tei]
                    if self.use_centroids:
                        pt_o = self.tri_cents[simp_i[0]]
                    else:
                        pt_o = self.tri_ccents[simp_i[0]]
                    dist_diff = bedge_mid - pt_o
                    intpt = bedge_mid + dist_diff
                    bsa = self.tri_sa[simp_i[0]]
                    vvertso = np.vstack((vvertso, intpt))
                    trisai = np.hstack((trisai, bsa))
        inds_vsort = self.cc_sort_inds(vvertso)
        vverts = vvertso[inds_vsort]
        trisaj = trisai[inds_vsort]
        vor_verts.extend(vverts)
        tri_sa_o.extend(trisaj)
        vcell_verts.append(vverts)
        vor_sa.append(self.area(vverts))
        vor_cents.append(self.poly_centroid(vverts))
        vedge_verts = np.asarray([[vi, vj] for vi, vj in zip(vverts, np.roll(vverts, -1, axis=0))])
        vor_edge_verts.extend(vedge_verts)
    self.vcell_verts = np.asarray(vcell_verts, dtype=object)
    self.vor_verts_duplicates = vor_verts * 1
    self.vor_verts = np.unique(np.asarray(vor_verts), axis=0)
    self.vor_sa = np.asarray(vor_sa)
    self.vor_cents = np.asarray(vor_cents)
    self.vor_edge_verts = np.unique(np.asarray(vor_edge_verts), axis=0)
    tri_sa_o = np.asarray(tri_sa_o)
    vord_tree = cKDTree(self.vor_verts_duplicates)
    _, vi = vord_tree.query(self.vor_verts)
    self.tri_sa_o = tri_sa_o[vi]

process_voredges.expression:
def process_voredges(self):
    logs.log_info('Calculating Voronoi edges...')
    all_edges = set()
    vedge_set = set()
    hull_points = []
    hull_edges = []
    vor_mids = []
    vor_tang = []
    vor_edge_len = []
    vor_cells = []
    vor_tree = cKDTree(self.vor_verts)
    if self.use_centroids:
        _, self.inner_vvert_i = vor_tree.query(self.tri_cents)
    else:
        _, self.inner_vvert_i = vor_tree.query(self.tri_ccents)
    for vpts in self.vcell_verts:
        di, vi = vor_tree.query(vpts)
        vor_cells.append(vi)
    for vedge in self.vor_edge_verts:
        di, vi = vor_tree.query(vedge)
        all_edges.add((vi[0], vi[1]))
    for va, vb in all_edges:
        if (va, vb) in all_edges and (vb, va) not in all_edges:
            hull_points.append(va)
            hull_points.append(vb)
            hull_edges.append([va, vb])
        if (vb, va) not in vedge_set:
            vedge_set.add((va, vb))
    self.bflags_vverts = np.unique(hull_points)
    vor_edges = np.asarray(list(vedge_set))
    vedge_tree = cKDTree(vor_edges)
    bflags_vedges = []
    for vi, vj in hull_edges:
        dedgea, ea = vedge_tree.query([vi, vj])
        dedgeb, eb = vedge_tree.query([vj, vi])
        if dedgea == 0.0:
            kk = ea
        elif dedgeb == 0.0:
            kk = eb
        bflags_vedges.append(kk)
    self.bflags_vedges = np.asarray(bflags_vedges)
    for ei, (vi, vj) in enumerate(vor_edges):
        vpi = self.vor_verts[vi]
        vpj = self.vor_verts[vj]
        tan_v = vpj - vpi
        vor_len = np.linalg.norm(tan_v)
        tan_vi = tan_v / vor_len
        assert np.round(vor_len, 15) != 0.0, 'Tri-edge length equal to zero! Duplicate seed points exist!'
        ppvm = (vpi + vpj) / 2
        vor_mids.append(ppvm)
        vor_edge_len.append(vor_len)
        vor_tang.append(tan_vi)
    vor_mids = np.asarray(vor_mids)
    vor_edge_len = np.asarray(vor_edge_len)
    vor_tang = np.asarray(vor_tang)
    self.vor_cells = np.asarray(vor_cells, dtype=object)
    vor_tree = cKDTree(vor_mids)
    di, map_vedge_to_tedge = vor_tree.query(self.tri_mids)
    vor_edges = np.asarray(vor_edges)
    self.vor_edges = vor_edges[map_vedge_to_tedge]
    self.vor_mids = vor_mids[map_vedge_to_tedge]
    self.vor_edge_len = vor_edge_len[map_vedge_to_tedge]
    self.vor_tang = vor_tang[map_vedge_to_tedge]
    for ei, (vti, tti) in enumerate(zip(self.vor_tang, self.tri_tang)):
        sign = np.sign(det1d(tti, vti))
        if sign == 1.0:
            self.vor_tang[ei] = -vti
            va, vb = self.vor_edges[ei]
            self.vor_edges[ei] = [vb, va]
    self.n_vedges = len(self.vor_edges)
    self.vor_edge_i = np.linspace(0, self.n_vedges - 1, self.n_vedges, dtype=int)
    self.n_vverts = len(self.vor_verts)
    self.n_vcells = len(self.vor_cells)
    self.vor_vert_i = np.linspace(0, self.n_vverts - 1, self.n_vverts, dtype=int)
    self.vor_cell_i = np.linspace(0, self.n_vcells - 1, self.n_vcells, dtype=int)
    xmin = self.vor_verts[:, 0].min()
    xmax = self.vor_verts[:, 0].max()
    ymin = self.vor_verts[:, 1].min()
    ymax = self.vor_verts[:, 1].max()
    self.xyaxis = [xmin * 1.1, xmax * 1.1, ymin * 1.1, ymax * 1.1]

def trimesh_core_calcs(self):
    """
        Figure out if there are super close points in the tri_verts set.

        Next check for triverts with really close circumcenters and, if
        necessary, merge to quads, or if requested, try merging as much of
        the mesh to quads as possible. Find ccents that are close to one
        another and mark cells for quad-merge.
        """
    tri_tree = cKDTree(self.tri_verts)
    di, ni = tri_tree.query(self.tri_verts, k=2)
    mark_for_merge = set()
    not_merged = set()
    for vi, tvertpts in enumerate(self.tri_verts):
        disti = di[vi, 1]
        indi = ni[vi, 1]
        near_point_check = disti / self.cell_radius
        if near_point_check < self.close_thresh:
            if vi not in not_merged:
                mark_for_merge.add(vi)
            not_merged.add(indi)
    mark_for_merge = np.asarray(list(mark_for_merge), dtype=int)
    self.tri_verts = np.delete(self.tri_verts, mark_for_merge, axis=0)
    trimesh = Delaunay(self.tri_verts)
    self.n_tverts = len(self.tri_verts)
    self.tri_vert_i = np.linspace(0, self.n_tverts - 1, self.n_tverts, dtype=int)
    tri_ccents = []
    tri_cents = []
    tri_rcircs = []
    tri_sa = []
    tcell_verts = []
    tri_cells = []
    for si, vert_inds in enumerate(trimesh.simplices):
        abc = trimesh.points[vert_inds]
        vx, vy, r_circ, r_in = self.circumc(abc[0], abc[1], abc[2])
        cx, cy = self.poly_centroid(abc)
        sa = self.area(abc)
        if self.use_alpha_shape:
            if r_circ < self.cell_radius / self.alpha_shape:
                if self.image_mask is not None:

def exact_partition(seeds, domain, work):
    """Successive exact half-plane clipping; no source dual coordinate is reused."""
    cells = []
    work.partial.update(source_seeds=seeds, explicit_domain=domain, unfinished_cells=cells)
    for owner, seed in enumerate(seeds):
        ring = _canonical_polygon(domain)
        for other, point in enumerate(seeds):
            if other != owner:
                incoming = dict(owner=owner, other=other, seed=seed, competitor=point)
                work.partial['current_bisector_input'] = incoming
                work.emit('bisector_input', incoming)
                ring = _clip(ring, _bisector(seed, point), work, owner, other)
        cells.append(ring)
    vertices = sorted({point for row in cells for point in row})
    if len(vertices) > MAX_VERTICES:
        raise ValueError('Complete shared vertex axis exceeds its declared bound')
    rings = []
    for row in cells:
        split = []
        for i, end in enumerate(row):
            start = row[i - 1]
            axis = 0 if end[0] != start[0] else 1
            on_edge = [point for point in vertices if polygons._on(start, end, point)]
            on_edge.sort(key=lambda point: (point[axis] - start[axis]) / (end[axis] - start[axis]))
            split.extend(on_edge[:-1])
        indices = [vertices.index(point) for point in split]
        first = indices.index(min(indices))
        rings.append(tuple(indices[first:] + indices[:first]))
    if sum(map(len, rings)) > MAX_HALF_EDGES:
        raise ValueError('Complete cell occurrence axis exceeds its declared bound')
    return (tuple(vertices), tuple(rings))
